I told Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats. Tobias posted that number in the same channel on Oct 14.

The number only comes from Tobias's message. I couldn't find a Marrow contract or account file to check it against, and I said so in the reply. Hollis is a member of #central-team, and a seat count is an account detail rather than a money term, so it was fine to share it there.
